announcements.noCodeHint: Attach a discount code and passengers get a “Use this offer” button that saves it to their account. It comes off their next fare automatically when they book in the app; they never see the code. Rides booked by dispatch get a discount only if you pick the code.
announcements.codeGoesPublic: This makes the discount available to every passenger who sees the offer. Codes you give out privately are not affected unless you attach them here.
announcements.bodyPlaceholder: Book any ride Fri–Sun and save 20%...
announcements.linksHint: Web links, phone numbers and email addresses become tappable in the app.

announcements.errButtonUrl: The link must start with https://
announcements.showPopupHint: Without this it goes to the inbox only. A popup appears when someone next opens the app, never in the middle of a ride or a booking.
announcements.repeatHint_once: Shown once on each phone. Reading it on any phone ends it everywhere.
announcements.repeatHint_until_tapped: Shown again on later visits until they open it or tap its button, up to the limit.
announcements.repeatHint_must_acknowledge: Can't be dismissed: drivers must tap “I understand”. You'll see who has.
announcements.endsWithCode: Ends no later than the discount code does.
announcements.pushOptOutHint: Passengers who turned off offers and promotions won't get the push; it is still in their inbox.
announcements.pushAtStart: The push goes out when it starts.
announcements.errWindow: The end has to be after the start.
announcements.previewCaption: Approximate. Phones use the company's colours.
announcements.editHint: Wording, button and end date can change. To change who it's for, the photo or the discount, end it and send a new one.
announcements.confirmEnd: End this now? It disappears from phones.
announcements.confirmDelete: Delete this? It disappears from phones and from this list.
announcements.confirmEndOffer: End this offer now? It disappears from phones, and passengers who saved it can no longer use it. Rides already booked keep their discount.

settlementHint.platformInvoiced: No driver/company Connect account was available at capture — funds are sitting on Vellon's balance. Coordinate with Vellon to collect this amount, then pay the driver directly.
settlementHint.retransferFailed: Vellon won this ride's dispute, but re-sending the driver/company's share failed. Pay them manually, then mark this resolved.
settlementHint.reversalFailed: A refund or dispute pulled the fare back, but Vellon couldn't claw the payout back from the driver/company's account (commonly: already paid out to their bank). Collect this amount from them directly, then mark resolved.
settlementHint.transferFailed: The automatic payout to the driver/company never went through. Pay them manually, then mark this resolved.
